facts.label: Passivo com by
facts.sub: It was broken by a ball. Pergunta: Who was it kicked by? Vários: The windows were repaired by a company. Sem by quando o agente não importa.

facts.label: Foi quebrado
facts.sub: Use was broken para algo que quebrou por causa de alguém ou algo. The window was broken by a ball. O particípio de break é broken, não breaked. Para vários, use were.

facts.label: Por + quem
facts.sub: Use by para dizer quem ou o que fez. It was kicked by a boy. The bill was paid by the parents’ group. Depois de by vem uma pessoa, um grupo ou uma coisa.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “The window was broken by a ball” uses by to name the agent.
We say “The window was broken from a ball”.
We can leave out by when the agent is not important.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “The window was broken by a ball” uses by to name the agent. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The window was broken from a ball”. → Falso (We say by.)
We can leave out by when the agent is not important. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A broken window at school · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning at a school in Auckland. Students stand in the yard and look at a broken window. Cora and Zoe study in the same class. Cora saw what happened before class. Now Zoe wants to hear the whole story. Cora tells it step by step.
“Zoe, the window was broken by a ball this morning!” says Cora. “Oh no! Who was it kicked by?” says Zoe. “It was kicked by a boy from the third year. He was very sorry.” says Cora.
